$comment: Curated Hugging Face selection for scheduled live ingestion. Repos are named first-party repositories of developers the catalog recognizes, fetched every run so their releases exist before any benchmark cites them; authors are those same developers, listed newest-modified first; derivatives are discovered only for variants Mutinai already knows. Base weights are listed before the instruct repos that declare them as their parent, so lineage resolves in one run. Edit deliberately: every entry adds review work. minLikes: community derivatives with fewer Hugging Face likes are not discovered (explicit --repos are unaffected).
